Look for waterproofing to around 10 m without a housing, strong stabilization with horizon leveling, and GoPro-style mounts. A bigger sensor matters at dawn, dusk and indoors. Claude and GPT choose the same product: GoPro HERO13 Black. https://1billionmodels.com/electronics/camera-and-photo/video-equipment/sports-and-action-video-cameras?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer
